# AIO Calculator

> Fast, free, modern online calculators with instant client-side computation. No sign-up, no paywalls, and no upload of personal financial or health data.

Website: https://aio-calculator.com/

## Core Principles
- All calculations run directly in the client browser where possible.
- Headings, mathematical formulas, worked examples, and FAQs are server-rendered as clean semantic HTML.
- Sourced and dated reference numbers (e.g., IRS tax brackets per Rev. Proc. 2025-32, WHO BMI classification, Freddie Mac PMMS mortgage reference rates).
- No hard-coded mandatory rates; all interest rates and brackets are user-editable.

## All Tool Categories & Direct URLs

### Financial Calculators
- [EMI Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/emi-calculator/): Calculate monthly instalment (EMI) for loans.
- [Loan Interest Analyzer](https://aio-calculator.com/loan-interest-analyzer/): Total interest analysis and loan cost comparison.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/mortgage-calculator/): Monthly mortgage payment with PITI (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance) and PMI.
- [Credit Card Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/credit-card-calculator/): Payoff timeline and interest savings between minimum and fixed payments.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/amortization-calculator/): Complete loan amortization schedule with monthly principal vs interest split.
- [SIP Investment Planner](https://aio-calculator.com/sip-investment-planner/): Systematic Investment Plan returns and wealth growth.
- [FD vs RD Comparison](https://aio-calculator.com/fd-vs-rd-comparison/): Fixed Deposit vs Recurring Deposit returns comparison.
- [Investment Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/investment-calculator/): Lump sum investment growth and compound balance projections.
- [Investment and ROI Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/investment-roi-calculator/): Return on investment percentage, annualized ROI, and profit.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/retirement-calculator/): Retirement nest egg requirements and sustainable withdrawal planning.
- [Budget Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/budget-calculator/): 50/30/20 monthly budget breakdown across needs, wants, and savings.
- [Savings Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/savings-calculator/): Target savings timeline and emergency fund growth with compound interest.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/income-tax-calculator/): Federal income tax, effective tax rate, and take-home pay estimate.
- [Currency and Inflation Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/currency-inflation-calculator/): Purchasing power erosion and historical/projected inflation impact.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/compound-interest-calculator/): Compound growth with regular monthly contributions and compounding frequency.
- [Home Affordability Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/home-affordability-calculator/): Maximum purchase price based on income, debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, and down payment.
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/rent-vs-buy-calculator/): Total cost comparison and break-even year between homeownership and renting.
- [Refinance Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/refinance-calculator/): Monthly savings, break-even months to recoup closing costs, and lifetime interest impact.
- [FIRE Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/fire-calculator/): Financial Independence, Retire Early targets, FIRE number, and years to financial freedom.

- [Paycheck Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/paycheck-calculator/): Gross to net take-home salary after federal tax, FICA (Social Security & Medicare), and deductions.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/auto-loan-calculator/): Car loan monthly payment, trade-in value, sales tax, and total financing interest.

- [BMI and Ideal Weight Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/bmi-ideal-weight-calculator/): Body Mass Index and Devine/Hamwi/Robinson ideal weight range.
- [BMI and Body Fat Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/bmi-body-fat-calculator/): U.S. Navy circumference method body fat percentage and fat mass vs lean mass.
- [Calorie Intake / Deficit Tracker](https://aio-calculator.com/calorie-intake-deficit-tracker/): Daily calorie targets for healthy sustainable weight loss or gain.
- [Calorie and Macro Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/calorie-macro-calculator/): Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE), BMR, and protein/carb/fat macro split.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/tdee-calculator/): Mifflin-St Jeor Total Daily Energy Expenditure by activity multiplier.
- [Fitness and Workout Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/fitness-workout-calculator/): MET-based workout calorie burn and target heart rate training zones.
- [Pregnancy Due Date Finder](https://aio-calculator.com/pregnancy-due-date-finder/): Estimated date of delivery (EDD) based on LMP, conception date, or ultrasound.
- [Steps to Km Converter](https://aio-calculator.com/steps-to-km-converter/): Walking and running step count to distance (km, miles) and calories burned.

- [Probability and Data Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/probability-data-calculator/): Combinations nCr, permutations nPr, single event and compound probability.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions with mixed numbers and simplification.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/percentage-calculator/): Percentage of a number, percentage increase/decrease, and percentage difference.
- [GPA Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/gpa-calculator/): Semester and cumulative Grade Point Average on 4.0 scale with weighted credits.
- [Final Grade Calculator](https://aio-calculator.com/final-grade-calculator/): Required final exam score needed to achieve a target course grade.
